exclusions: Accidents that took place before the cover start date or date of reinstatement
War, riot, revolution or any similar event
Terrorism involving the use of nuclear, biological or chemical agents
Illnesses of any kind, fits, hernia, venereal disease, or AIDS
Any infectious disease not listed under the Medical Reimbursement benefit
Physical or mental defect or infirmity existing at the cover start date
Accidents arising from pregnancy, confinement or related complications
Deliberate acts including taking intoxicating liquor or drugs, suicide or attempted suicide, or intentional self-injury
Unlawful acts or deliberately recklessly putting oneself in unnecessary danger
Death or injury from committing, attempting or provoking an assault, crime, or breaking the law
State of unsound mind
Dangerous activities unless specifically covered under the high-risk activities provisions
Professional or competitive sports where the life assured earns income or pay
Being in an aircraft of any type except as a fare-paying passenger on a scheduled commercial airline
Radiation or contamination from radioactivity
Racing of all kinds other than on foot or bicycle
Commando or bomb-disposal duties, active military duties, or travel by military aircraft or waterborne vessel
Any pre-existing medical condition
Infectious disease diagnosed within 14 days of cover start date
Infectious disease announced as an epidemic by Singapore health authority or pandemic by WHO
coverage_gaps: No life insurance coverage for natural death — this is a personal accident policy covering accidental death only
No Integrated Shield Plan or comprehensive hospitalisation coverage — medical reimbursement is limited to $2,000 per accident (Plan A)
No income protection or disability income benefit
No coverage for illness-related death or disability
